{{Quote|The orchard vine on your desk. Also from the Corporate Sector. Also expensive.|[[Jahan Cross]], to [[Milosh Muhrlein]]|<ref name="AotE" />}}
'''Orchard vines''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The plants consisted of a large central [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Flower/Legends|flower]] with orange protrusions, which was surrounded by pink and yellow leaves.<ref name="AotE" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] these plants were considered luxurious, accessible only to the wealthy. [[Rossum Droidworks]], a company based in the Corporate sector, sent an orchard vine as a gift to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]], the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commandant]] of [[Imperial Research Station 61]] on the planet [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. Muhrlein, who sold experimental [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and technology from his research station on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] to Rossum, kept the plant on [[Gender/Legends|his]] desk until [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Jahan Cross]] recognized it around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. Cross, who was investigating the commandant's black market dealings, later knocked it to the floor while fighting Muhrlein.<ref name="AotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orchard vine was featured in [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Stéphane Roux]]. The name of this plant sounds very similar to the [[D'ian orchid vine|orchid vine]] mentioned in earlier book sources. However, despite the possibility of a typo in the comic, the two plants have completely different appearances and share nothing in common — except perhaps their similar-sounding names.
